sprite.description: A game object sprite seen from the front (piece, item, character).
sprite.prompt: {subject}, single game object, centered, front view, {style}, plain light grey background, no text
sprite.negative: text, letters, watermark, signature, frame, border, multiple objects, cropped, blurry, noisy, photo, realistic hands

background.prompt: {subject}, soft game background, low contrast, calm, empty center area for a puzzle board, {style}, no text
background.negative: text, letters, watermark, characters, busy details, high contrast, blurry

icon.description: A UI button icon (hint, undo, reset, settings, shop).
icon.prompt: {subject} icon, simple bold silhouette, centered, mobile game UI icon, {style}, plain light grey background, no text
icon.negative: text, letters, watermark, thin lines, tiny details, multiple icons, frame, blurry
